messages:
omar_sales: Quick handoff — PineBridge Health signed SOW today. High-level: private VPC deployment planned, SSO via Okta, and pilot for claims-processing assistant. Renewal conversation flagged for month 5 due to budget cycle. cc @sara_cs for onboarding.
sara_cs: Thanks Omar — picking this up. Who's the primary technical contact at PineBridge?
omar_sales: Primary is Priya Kapoor (Dir of ML infra). Priya@example.com. They want a dedicated GPU pool (est. 2x A100) + audit logging. Also ask: will need dev sandbox for their engineers next week.
sara_cs: Got it. I'll schedule kickoff. Owners: Sara (CS) for onboarding, Ben (Eng) for private deploy + perf runbooks, Lee (Support) for post-go-live SLOs.
sara_cs: Risks: procurement timeline could push deployment past their internal pilot window (4w). Renewal risk if pilot misses KPIs. Need clear success metrics.
ben_eng: Re: infra — I'll own the deploy plan. Can we get their model artifacts and target latency/throughput? Also need network CIDR for VPC peering.
lee_support: I'll draft an incident routing plan and set up a support Slack channel with PineBridge. Also will add them to our status page.
omar_sales: Priya confirmed artifacts + a short perf target: p95 < 250ms for 512 tokens, 50 reqs/s steady. She also asked about token-level cost forecasting.
sara_cs: Action items I propose: 1) Kickoff w/ PineBridge + internal owners — Wed 10am PT. 2) Ben: perf validation plan + quant/latency tradeoffs (due EOD Fri). 3) Lee: support runbook + oncall rotas (due next Tue). 4) Omar: share procurement timeline and PO contact. 5) Sara: assemble success metrics doc and feedback form.
ben_eng: I'll need access to a sample model and input distribution. Can PineBridge upload to our secure bucket? Omar — can you coordinate?
omar_sales: I'll send the upload link and contact this afternoon. Also looping in Priya in the kickoff invite.
sara_cs: For feedback capture during pilot: we'll use a short weekly survey + a dedicated Jira project for product/quality issues. Template snippet below:
```
- Week 1: latency, error-rate, relevancy score (team-rated 1-5)
- Week 2: edge cases, hallucinations, prompt stability notes
- Week 3: ROI signals (time saved per claim), adoption metrics
```
sara_cs: @ben_eng @lee_support can you confirm you can triage Jira tickets tagged `pilot-blocker` within 24h?
ben_eng: Yes. We'll prioritize `pilot-blocker` and `perf-regression`.
lee_support: Confirmed. I'll also ensure escalation to oncall if P1.
ops-bot: Reminder: kickoff meeting scheduled Wed 2026-03-25 10:00 PT — calendar invites sent to participants.
sara_cs: Meeting agenda (short): intros, success metrics, deployment timeline, access + credentials, immediate blockers. I'll attach the success metrics doc and the onboarding checklist before the meeting.
omar_sales: One more note — finance prefers a three-tiered commit (pilot, ramp, production). That may affect Dedicated sizing. Sara, please include ramp thresholds in the doc.
sara_cs: Will do. Next steps summary: Sara to send agenda + success metrics; Omar to share upload link + procurement contact; Ben to draft perf validation; Lee to draft support runbook. I'll follow up with a tracker and share weekly status updates.
ben_eng: I'll also add a short perf test script and a reproducible runbook: `run_perf.sh --model pinebridge-v1 --tokens 512 --concurrency 50`.
sara_cs: Thanks team :thumbsup: Priya, welcome aboard — we'll handle ops and keep close cadence. Any immediate asks from PineBridge before Wed?
omar_sales: Priya asked if we can demo streaming responses and function-calling for claims enrichment — add to agenda.
sara_cs: Noted. Adding `demo: streaming + function-calls` to agenda. See you all Wed.
